text: {"question": "What was the daily dosage and maximum duration of mitiperstat evaluated in the phase 2a trial for COPD?", "answer": "Participants in the trial were evaluated with a daily dose of 5 mg of mitiperstat for a duration of up to 24 weeks.", "evidence": "This phase 2a, randomised, placebo-controlled, double-blind, parallel-arm, event-driven trial evaluated the efficacy and safety of mitiperstat 5 mg daily up to 24 weeks (NCT05492877)."}
